page.layout: One page of text, single column of verse and epigrams with headings in italics and underlined titles; a small "N" signature mark and a handwritten manuscript note at the foot, which is not printed text. Running head at top: "EPIGRAM. A FAYT." with page number at top right.

main_text.p: Venturas coelo poenas, irasque minasque Demonstrat terris exitiale scelus.
main_text.head: Οὐρανοσκόπος Piscis. Coelum petere mente.
main_text.p: Non oculis petitur coelum, sed mente: quid ergo Assiduis spectas sydera luminibus?
Est piscis coelum semper spectare suetus: De coelo nunquam cogitat ille tamen.
Mobile sic coelum specta, quo possit ad orbem Qui mouet immotus, mens penetrare, Deum.
main_text.head: Libido effrænis.
main_text.p: Ecce ratem, nullus quam Typhis dirigit, & quam Perdendam in scopulos impetus vrget aquæ.
Sic ruit in præceps rectæ rationis egenus, Quem male perdendum caeca libido rapit.
main_text.head: Ad illud Matthæi 22. Reddite Cæsari quæ sunt Cæsaris.
main_text.p: Cæsaris effigies, sculpto quam cernis in ære, Ipsis Cæsaribus danda tributa monet.
Numinis effigies homo, cum sis, reddito, debes Te siquidem totum, numinis obsequio.
main_text.head: In Hypocritam insignem. Ad illud Horatii lib. epist. 1. Quod si pallerent casu, biberent exangue Cuminum.
main_text.p: Te quidam memorant vesci persæpe Cumino. Seius id laudat, vituperat Titius.
At mea si quæris quæ sit sententia, dicam: Vis pallere, tibi fit cibus ille frequens.
Pallentes reddit vultus exangue Cuminum: Tetricus hac a te quæritur arte color.

page.notes: Handwritten manuscript note in ink at the foot ("Vulg. Innocentius 3 ... Dominus ... Jerusalem") is not printed text and is omitted. Underlining and a cross mark in the margin are annotations. Some words in the Greek heading are uncertain. Show-through from the reverse side is present.
